summary.text: The revised pricing page renames a plan, changes three amounts and changes Business availability to Contact sales.

changes.explanation: A plan heading changes from Team to Growth.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This renames a plan shown on the pricing page.

changes.explanation: In the Starter plan, the number changes from 10 to 15.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This changes a stated figure in a plan.

changes.explanation: The Growth plan price changes from $15 to $18.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This makes the Growth plan a worse deal.

changes.explanation: Another Growth plan price changes from $19 to $16, a decrease of $3.
The Business plan changes from Available to Contact sales.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This may change how the Business plan can be obtained.

changes.explanation: In About Tasklane, the number changes from 12,000 to 13,000.
changes.why_it_may_matter: Impact could not be determined from the documents.

changes.explanation: A link changes from https://tasklane.example.com/blog to https://tasklane.example.com/news.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This changes where a link on the page leads.
